integrity: The infinite identity and normal limit are supported by the written carry-matrix proof. The standalone finite verifier checks exact independent arithmetic but is not an infinite proof. No independent expert audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the prime 3 and aligned integer blocks [0,3^L) are treated; no uniform local limit theorem, off-grid distribution, or multi-prime joint result is claimed. The complete Alter--Kubota (1973) text was not accessible, so priority over unlocated stronger statements is not certified.
title: Exact ternary-block distribution and Gaussian law for three-adic Catalan valuations
